name: Relay
description: Reply debt, cleared. Reads your Telegram open loops and sends voice-drafted replies from Even G2.

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Fetches your ranked reply brief and sends replies you approve through the Relay server.

permissions.desc: Records a short voice reply while you hold the ring. Audio is sent to your Relay server for transcription and is not stored.
